correctness.rationale: Each weight-two word is uniquely 0^a 1 0^b 1 0^c with a+b+c=n-2. Two-one Abelian squares are exactly 0^u 1 0^b 1 0^v satisfying 0≤u≤a,0≤v≤c, |u-v|≤b and parity u+b+v≡0 mod2; zero-only classes add floor(max(a,b,c)/2). Each pair defines a literal distinct factor. Strip lattice counts are uniformly half the area up to O(n), and gap triples rescale to Dirichlet(1,1,1). Independently enumerated all 560 two-one words of lengths 2–15 and their literal factor sets, exactly reproducing count formula. Independently integrated all six polynomial simplex sectors in exact SymPy rational arithmetic to get E[A]=1/24, E[A²]=5/1728; the proposed L=A/2 has mean 1/48, second moment 5/6912, variance 1/3456. Bounded convergence of moments follows from the uniform error; finite checks are corroboration only.
